title: Phase 0 deterministic harness smoke test
description: Validates Work Unit loading, manifest validation, deterministic execution, result normalization, and provenance. This is infrastructure validation, not a scientific benchmark.

hypotheses.statement: The same configuration and seed produce the same deterministic smoke_score.
hypotheses.falsification: Two runs with identical experiment id, configuration id, and seed emit different smoke_score values.

hypotheses.statement: Every emitted result conforms to experiment-result-v0.1.schema.json.
hypotheses.falsification: Any emitted result fails schema validation.

configurations.description: Metadata fixture representing three independent workers; the smoke runner still performs no external agent calls.

metrics.name: smoke_score
metrics.description: Deterministic infrastructure checksum-like score; not a quality metric.

environment.notes: Requires the jsonschema Python package for validation.
